recompra.descripcion: When each customer will buy again.

ciclos.descripcion: How often each product gets repurchased.

ofertas.descripcion: Products to offer each customer based on their repurchase.

periodo.ayuda: Limits the purchases considered to this date range; empty uses the whole history.

min_compras.ayuda: Minimum purchases of a customer on a product to take it into account.

horizonte.ayuda: How many days ahead the likely repurchase dates are calculated.

umbral.ayuda: Minimum repurchase probability to generate a reminder (0 to 1).

parametros.descripcion: The defaults work well for most cases.

ofertas_lista.ayuda: CSV with columns producto_id,descuento; without a list, offers are computed from co-purchase only.

errores.tipos_invalidos: There is an invalid analysis type.
errores.parametros_invalidos: Check the parameters, one of them is invalid.
errores.ofertas_codificacion: The offers file isn't in a valid text format.
errores.ofertas_columnas: The offers CSV must have the producto_id and descuento columns.
errores.ofertas_fila_invalida: There is an invalid row in the offers CSV.
errores.ofertas_muy_grande: The offers file is too large.

nuevo.descripcion: Choose what you want to know about your customers and tune the parameters if needed.

progreso.esperando: Waiting for the analysis to start…
